step_checks.derivation: Own P30 growth engine, seed 26521, 1024 to 65536 sites, two-carrier absorption, explicit exclusion-limited hops, w=1, four alternating-cycle warmups, tightest eligible cuts. Whole-body walk reading (ds16+ds32)/2=1.8759901, seat about1.85. Slopes rise to2.088 at tau128; no asymptotic ds=2 theorem follows.

Remove all incident links of a random5% of both-written pairs. Largest live component63794; reading1.8400770, change-.035913, below .2. This reproduces the small-lock result at one scanned point; not the full lock/age/ring panel.

Own26^3x4 open-time slab, periodic spatial axes; walk reading3.258614, ball slopes2.84,2.90,2.92 at r4,6,8. Shell-difference beta .886,.851,.954 at r2,3,4; all unsaturated. A known3D live graph is detected.

Solve (D-A)phi=delta-1/N with independent conjugate gradients, relative residual<1e-8. Whole beta[-.252,.102,.125] fails1/r. Small-lock beta[.127,.833,1.572] has no two adjacent passing radii and fails the seat's beta2>=.5 safeguard. Thus no1/r in these samples.

step_checks.grade: DOWNGRADE general no-go wording to finite numerical evidence
step_checks.derivation: Rayleigh monotonicity concerns effective resistance/recurrence on an infinite specified network, not monotonicity of every finite-time spectral slope after pruning. Neither finite ds~2 nor a few plateau octaves proves recurrence or that no untested locking can help. No physical force or hydrogen spectrum is derived from a graph Green function alone.

disagreements_with_first_check: No first-check pin was supplied for LF; comparison is directly with the seat.

The categorical statement 'whole network must walk above2 before any lock can help' exceeds the finite-size evidence unless an infinite recurrent limit and appropriate relation between diffusion and potential decay are established.
corrections: Report scale drift and stochastic-estimator error; sampled-vector uncertainty is not seed-to-seed growth uncertainty.
Keep the result confined to the tested body/protocol and lock point. No upgrade and no universal lock no-go theorem.
plain_summary: A fresh 65,536-site growth run reproduces the negative geometry result: the whole-body walk reading is 1.876, versus about 1.85 in the seat. Small pair locks lower it slightly to 1.840 and do not produce a one-over-distance field. The independent live-slab control reads 3.259, with field-decay exponents 0.85–0.95, so the test detects the intended behaviour. This supports the finite numerical finding. It does not prove that every possible locking rule fails or that the infinite grown network has dimension exactly two.
